# XUtil

> 63 free developer tools that run entirely in the browser: encoders, decoders, converters, generators, formatters and image utilities. No ads, no accounts, no data leaves the page.

Every tool is a single page. Paste or type on the left, the result appears on the right as you type, and every result has a Copy button. Each page ends with an explainer and FAQ about the format or conversion it handles.

## Encode & decode

- [GUID Generator](https://xutil.in/guid): One or many UUIDs, version 4 or 7.
- [ULID Generator](https://xutil.in/ulid): Sortable 26-character IDs with a time prefix.
- [Password Generator](https://xutil.in/password): Random passwords with length and character-set controls.
- [Hash Generator](https://xutil.in/hash): MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384, SHA-512 and HMAC for text or a file.
- [Base64 Encoder / Decoder](https://xutil.in/base): Base64, Base32 and Base58 in both directions.
- [ROT13 / Caesar Cipher](https://xutil.in/cipher): Shift letters by any amount, or ROT13 in one click.
- [JWT Decoder](https://xutil.in/jwt): Read a token’s header and payload without sending it anywhere.
- [URL Encoder / Decoder](https://xutil.in/eurl): Percent-encode text for URLs, or decode it back.
- [HTML Entities](https://xutil.in/html): Escape &, < and > for HTML, or unescape them.
- [Morse Code Translator](https://xutil.in/morse): Text to dots and dashes, and back.

## Data formats

- [XML ⇄ JSON](https://xutil.in/xml_json): Convert between XML and JSON, from text or a file.
- [YAML ⇄ JSON](https://xutil.in/yaml_json): Convert between YAML and JSON, from text or a file.
- [CSV ⇄ JSON](https://xutil.in/csv_json): Convert between CSV and JSON, from text or a file.
- [JSON to TypeScript](https://xutil.in/json_ts): Infer TypeScript interfaces from a JSON sample.
- [JSON to Python Dataclass](https://xutil.in/json_python): Infer Python dataclasses from a JSON sample.
- [JSON to Pydantic Model](https://xutil.in/json_pydantic): Infer Pydantic models from a JSON sample.
- [Base Number Converter](https://xutil.in/base_number): Binary, octal, decimal, hex and any base up to 36.
- [Text ⇄ Binary / Hex](https://xutil.in/text_base): Text to binary, hex, octal or decimal, and back.
- [Unix ⇄ UTC](https://xutil.in/unix_utc): Epoch seconds or milliseconds to a readable date, and back.
- [Timezone Converter](https://xutil.in/timezone): Convert a time between cities, with DST handled.
- [Cron Converter](https://xutil.in/cron): Describe a schedule in words and get the cron expression.

## Units & measures

- [Angle](https://xutil.in/angle): Degrees, radians, gradians and turns.
- [Area](https://xutil.in/area): Square metres, feet, acres and hectares.
- [Bits / Bytes](https://xutil.in/bit_byte): Bits, bytes and every prefix up to petabytes.
- [Energy](https://xutil.in/energy): Joules, calories, kilowatt-hours and BTU.
- [Frequency](https://xutil.in/frequency): Hertz, kilohertz, megahertz and RPM.
- [Fuel Economy](https://xutil.in/fuel_economy): Miles per gallon, km per litre and litres per 100 km.
- [Length](https://xutil.in/length): Metres, feet, miles, inches and nautical miles.
- [Power](https://xutil.in/power): Watts, kilowatts and horsepower.
- [Pressure](https://xutil.in/pressure): Pascals, bar, PSI and atmospheres.
- [Speed](https://xutil.in/speed): km/h, mph, knots and metres per second.
- [Temperature](https://xutil.in/temperature): Celsius, Fahrenheit and Kelvin.
- [Time Unit](https://xutil.in/time): Seconds, minutes, hours, days and beyond.
- [Volume](https://xutil.in/volume): Litres, gallons, pints and cubic metres.
- [Weight](https://xutil.in/weight): Kilograms, pounds, ounces and stone.

## Text & code

- [Lorem Ipsum Generator](https://xutil.in/lorem): Placeholder paragraphs, sentences or words.
- [Slug Generator](https://xutil.in/slug): Turn a title into a URL-safe slug.
- [Text Compare](https://xutil.in/text_compare): Diff by line, word or character, unified or side by side.
- [URL Parser](https://xutil.in/url_parser): Break a URL into host, path, query and fragment.
- [JSON Formatter & Validator](https://xutil.in/json_validator): Validate, pretty-print or minify JSON.
- [Text Case Converter](https://xutil.in/text_case): camelCase, snake_case, kebab-case, Title Case and more.
- [Markdown Previewer](https://xutil.in/markdown): Render Markdown as you type.
- [Whitespace Remover](https://xutil.in/line_break_whitespace_remover): Strip line breaks, extra spaces or both.
- [Duplicate Line Remover](https://xutil.in/duplicate_line_remover): Keep each line once.
- [String Counter](https://xutil.in/string_counter): Characters, words, lines and bytes.
- [Regex Tester](https://xutil.in/regex): Test a pattern against text with live matches.
- [Regex Cheatsheet](https://xutil.in/regex_cheatsheet): Regular-expression syntax with examples.

## Word play

- [Palindrome Checker](https://xutil.in/palindrome): Does it read the same backwards?
- [String Reverser / Rotator](https://xutil.in/string_reverser_rotator): Reverse a string or rotate it by n characters.
- [Roman Numeral Converter](https://xutil.in/roman_numeral): 1984 ⇄ MCMLXXXIV.
- [NATO Phonetic Alphabet](https://xutil.in/nato_phonetic): Spell text out as Alfa, Bravo, Charlie.
- [Pig Latin Converter](https://xutil.in/pig_latin): English to Pig Latin and back.
- [Numeronym Generator](https://xutil.in/numeronym): internationalization → i18n.
- [Leetspeak Translator](https://xutil.in/leetspeak): Text to l33t and back.
- [Word Frequency Counter](https://xutil.in/word_frequency_counter): Which words appear most, and how often.

## Images & colour

- [QR Code Generator](https://xutil.in/qr_code): QR codes for text, links, Wi-Fi and contacts.
- [Barcode Generator](https://xutil.in/barcode_generator): EAN, UPC, Code 128 and more as SVG or PNG.
- [Barcode / QR Reader](https://xutil.in/barcode_reader): Decode a barcode or QR code from an image.
- [Color Picker](https://xutil.in/color_picker): Pick a colour and copy it in every format.
- [Favicon Generator](https://xutil.in/favicon): Every favicon size from one image.
- [Image Compressor](https://xutil.in/image_compressor): Shrink a JPEG, PNG or WebP in the browser.
- [Gradient Generator](https://xutil.in/gradient_generator): Build a CSS gradient and copy the rule.
- [Box Shadow Generator](https://xutil.in/box_shadow_generator): Tune a shadow and copy the CSS.

## Optional

- [Source on GitHub](https://github.com/RohitPModani/xutil): the full source code (React + TypeScript).
